## About
Airport Auto Rebuilders is a family owned and operated shop. Mark Zoller opened the doors with quality first in mind, and his son Eric Zoller manages the shop today. Most of our work comes from referrals from customers who were happy with their cars.
Our technicians are I-CAR and BASF refinishing trained and certified. We match paint with a BASF mixing system and computerized color matching, refinish in a Binks spray booth, and straighten frames and unibodies on a Chief EZliner frame machine.
We're members of the Better Business Bureau, and our customers have given us a 4.6 rating from 121 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Accident repair on domestic and foreign cars.
- Automotive refinishing: Refinish work mixed on a BASF system, with computerized color matching.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents taken out without repainting.
- Lease return repair: Get your car looking right before you turn in your lease.
- Stock and custom paint: From factory colors to custom work, including flames.
- Motorcycle repair and refinishing: Body and paint work for bikes too.
- Vinyl graphics and lettering: Graphics and lettering for your vehicle, plus pinstriping.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance claims?
A: Yes, insurance claims are welcome. Contact us for details about our insurance claims assistance.

Q: Do you fix foreign cars?
A: Yes. We do collision repair on both domestic and foreign vehicles.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Saturdays are by appointment, and we're closed on Saturdays during the summer. Give us a call to check.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Every job is different, so give us a call for pricing.
